Hi Michael / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. I wanted to capture the key points for your exec team and confirm next steps so we keep momentum toward a Q1 procurement decision. High-level recap below (happy to adjust if I missed anything):

1) Business context & outcomes
- Zenovate is prioritizing faster, more reliable LLM-powered customer summaries and automated triage across Support and Sales.
- Target outcome: 30-40% reduction in average handle time (AHT) for customer inquiries and 20% improvement in lead routing accuracy within 6 months.

2) Pain points (current state)
- Latency and variability from current vendor causing timeouts at peak.
- High per-token cost for real-time inference on large prompt windows.
- Difficulty scaling to ~1500 concurrent requests during peak support hours without burst capacity.

3) Success criteria / goals
- Sub-300ms tail latency at p95 for 1-2k concurrent inference requests.
- Predictable unit economics: target blended cost per 1K generated tokens.
- Private deployment options for regulated customer data (VPC + KMS).

4) Procurement path & timeline (what we heard)
- Exec sponsor: Michael Hayes (you) - interested in outcome benefits and risk exposure.
- Procurement / Legal: Leo Mills to be engaged for SOW/MSA and procurement timeline.
- Target procurement window: 30-60 days (internal approvals + security review).

5) Risks / open questions
- Security review: SOC 2 report and SOC 2 auditor contact requested (we can share SOC 2 Type II + pen test summary).
- Data residency / retention policy details for regulated cohorts.
- Integration work: estimated engineering effort to replace current inference endpoints (~2-3 sprints).

6) Proposed next steps (owners & timeline)
- Aditya: send executive one-pager + tailored recap (attached) and draft SOW for budgeting (attached). (Today)
- Marissa: follow up with proposed pricing tiers + sample deployment configuration for Dedicated / Private. (by Tue 2/17)
- Michael: confirm internal exec review slot and loop in Leo (procurement). (this week)
- Marissa / Laura: schedule security call with your InfoSec and our Security team. (by EOW)

Attachments: redwood-exec-recap.pdf (one-pager for leadership), redwood-sow-draft.docx (SOW template to start budgeting).

If that aligns with your view, I’ll schedule a 30-min exec review with Michael + Michael’s direct report and our CTO/Head of Product for Wed 2/18.

Thanks —
